name: Path of Defense
summary: At the Far Watch Post, Uzzek prepares young Horde warriors to defend those who cannot defend themselves. He sends them to Thunder Ridge to prove their endurance against its electric beasts.

sections.title: The Shield of the Horde
sections.body: At the Far Watch Post, Uzzek teaches young warriors that defense is part of the Horde's duty. The post lies on the border between the Barrens and Durotar. Uzzek says a warrior's highest calling is to stand between danger and those unable to defend themselves, taking the blows so the Horde can endure.

sections.title: Trial of Thunder
sections.body: Uzzek sends the novices to Thunder Ridge, north across the Southfury River in Durotar, to test their stamina and resolve. Thunder lizards and lightning hides roam the canyon. The initiates must survive the beasts' jolts and harvest their singed scales to show they have the fortitude to hold the front line.

faq.q: Who gives the Path of Defense quest?
faq.answer: Veteran Uzzek gives the trial at the Far Watch Post, which guards the border between Durotar and the eastern Barrens.
Thunder Ridge lies in western Durotar, north of the main road, across the bridge over the Southfury River. Aggressive thunder lizards and lightning hides roam its ravine.

faq.q: Why does Uzzek demand singed scales specifically?
faq.answer: Uzzek asks for singed scales from the shock-wielding beasts of Thunder Ridge. Enduring their electrical attacks proves a warrior has the toughness and resilience to learn advanced defensive techniques.

faq.q: What is the philosophical lesson behind this trial?
faq.answer: Uzzek teaches that being a warrior is not merely about slaughter, but about shielding others. Surviving the beasts' fury helps initiates learn to protect weaker allies.

faq.q: What comes next after completing Path of Defense?
faq.answer: After you prove your defensive mettle to Uzzek, he directs you to continue your martial training with Thun'grim Firegaze.
No. This rite is for warriors, and tests and teaches recruits the basics of guard duty and defensive combat.

angles.text: As a warrior, you begin learning defensive discipline: true martial strength lies in shielding your allies from devastation.
At the Far Watch Post, Horde guards protect the road into the Barrens, so their resilience matters to Horde security.
